mini-ipip.validation: Published English short form. Project Ukrainian translation is not psychometrically validated.
mini-ipip.note: IPIP places its items and scales in the public domain for any purpose, including translation.

ipip-neo-120.validation: Published English inventory. Project Ukrainian translation is not psychometrically validated.
ipip-neo-120.note: IPIP places its items and scales in the public domain for any purpose, including translation.

ipip-hexaco-hh.validation: IPIP proxy for preliminary HEXACO-PI facets, not the proprietary HEXACO-PI-R. Project Ukrainian translation is not psychometrically validated.
ipip-hexaco-hh.note: IPIP places its items and scales in the public domain for any purpose, including translation.

ipip-via.validation: Revised IPIP-VIA proxy, not the proprietary VIA Inventory of Strengths. Project Ukrainian translation is not psychometrically validated.
ipip-via.note: IPIP places its items and scales in the public domain for any purpose, including translation.

gse.note: The authors' FAQ grants reproduction for research studies with credit. Public redistribution, commercial software and translation are not clearly covered. Private only until written clarification.

ncs-6.validation: Published English short form. Project Ukrainian translation is not psychometrically validated.
ncs-6.note: The article and appendix carry CC BY 4.0, but the six items derive from older Need for Cognition Scale content whose rights are unresolved. Private only until clarified.

onet-ip-sf.validation: Published English career-interest measure. Its use for collaboration guidance is not validated.
onet-ip-sf.note: Verbatim redistribution is allowed under CC BY-ND 4.0; modified content or purpose needs the Developer License and validation. Private only until an audit of the current integration confirms compliance.

cbi-work.validation: Published English work-related burnout scale, used here report-only and non-diagnostic.
cbi-work.note: NFA permits commercial and noncommercial use with the Borritz et al. (2006) citation. The grant does not discuss translation, so the project Ukrainian overlay is private only until NFA confirms.
